remarks.name: Boris Cherny
remarks.role: Claude Code anthropicai
remarks.text:
I used Opus 5.5 to formally verify the Claude Agent SDK using Lean. A couple short prompts = 16 PRs fixing various bugs and race conditions. Video attached.

TLA+ also works well. I sometimes combine Lean and TLA+ to look for issues around data flow, concurrency, and state mgmt.

I don't know either language well, but Claude is excellent at both. This approach is super useful for formally modeling your code and finding bugs that a human probably wouldn't have spotted.

Is formal verification the future of coding (or at least, bug finding)?
remarks.translation: 我使用 Opus 5.5 通过 Lean 对 Claude Agent SDK 进行了形式化验证。几个简短的提示词 = 16 个 PR，修复了各种 bug 和竞态条件。视频附上。TLA+ 也同样效果很好。我有时会结合 Lean 和 TLA+ 来查找数据流、并发和状态管理方面的问题。我对这两种语言都不太熟悉，但 Claude 对两者都很擅长。这种方法对于对你的代码进行形式化建模，并发现人类可能不会察觉的 bug 非常有用。形式化验证是编程的未来吗（或者至少，是发现 bug 的未来）？
remarks.observation: 这条言论可作为 Agent 产品形态、协作方式或能力边界的观察入口；只代表公开观点，不作为公司事实主证据。

remarks.name: Nikunj Kothari
remarks.role: partner fpvventures - investing in seed/A. previous: early hire meter, opendoor, atlassian & others. love shimoleejhaveri + 👦👧
remarks.text:
The amount of SPVs organzied by even the “best” investors is simply mind boggling..

To the point that if you read headlines of a large fundraise, you can be reasonably sure now that a large amount of it came from SPVs even though the headlines say something else. 

Combine that with tranched valuations and revenue not being the same, all I’ll say don’t believe the headlines anymore. 

Proof is in the pudding and the pudding is not publicly visible anywhere.
remarks.translation: 即便是由所谓“最优秀”的投资者所组织的SPV数量，也简直令人难以置信……以至于现在当你读到某笔大规模融资的头条新闻时，你几乎可以合理确定其中很大一部分资金来自SPV，尽管头条上说的完全是另一回事。再叠加上分轮估值以及收入并不等同这些因素，我只能说：别再相信头条新闻了。证据就在布丁里，而这块布丁在任何公开场合都看不到。

remarks.name: Aaron Levie
remarks.role: ceo box - your business lives in content. unleash it with AI
remarks.text:
What an insane day in AI. The frontier models just became substantially cheaper, with the Opus 5.5 price cuts, and now with GPT-6 Sol and Luna dropping token prices by 50%.

The rate at which the cost per task (on a like-for-like basis) drops in AI is unlike any other type of technology in history. And every time the cost of AI drops, the use-cases you can deploy agents against dramatically increase. This is Jevons paradox applied to agents.

These improvements will directly lead to broader diffusion of AI in the economy as we can use agents to process all of our data, scan our code for security issues, read through all log data to make decisions, have agent swarms in workflows, and much more. The cost of tokens is directly correlated to these use-cases being opened up at scale.
remarks.translation: AI领域真是疯狂的一天。前沿模型刚刚大幅降价，Opus 5.5价格下调，现在GPT-6 Sol和Luna又把token价格降低了50%。AI中每个任务成本（在同类对比基础上）下降的速度，是历史上任何其他技术都无法比拟的。而每当AI成本下降，你可以部署智能体来应对的用例就会急剧增加。这就是杰文斯悖论在智能体上的应用。这些改进将直接推动AI在经济中更广泛地扩散，因为我们可以用智能体来处理我们所有的数据、扫描代码中的安全问题、通读所有日志数据来做决策、在工作流中部署智能体集群，等等。token成本与这些用例能否大规模开放直接相关。
remarks.observation: 这条言论可作为 Agent 产品形态、协作方式或能力边界的观察入口；只代表公开观点，不作为公司事实主证据。

remarks.name: Alex Albert
remarks.role: Research AnthropicAI. Opinions are my own!
remarks.text:
Prompt in Claude Tag

"Recreate Market Street, San Francisco as it stood on April 17, 1906, the afternoon before the earthquake, in Blender.

Scope: the Ferry Building up Market to Fifth Street, including the Palace Hotel, the Call Building, the Chronicle Building, Lotta's Fountain and the Emporium.

Before modeling anything, build a source file from: the 1899-1905 Sanborn fire insurance maps (footprints, heights, materials, occupants), the Miles Brothers film "A Trip Down Market Street" (April 1906), period photographs from OpenSFHistory, the Library of Congress and the David Rumsey collection, and USGS topography. Record every building with footprint, height, facade material, occupant, and the source for each fact with a confidence level.

Build everything in Blender Python. No downloaded meshes, textures or HDRIs. Write reusable generators (Victorian commercial facade, mansard roof, bay windows, awnings, painted signage, gas and electric street lamps, cable car, horse-drawn wagon, early automobile) and assemble the street from the source file, so every building traces back to data.

Provide a 10 second video up the street."
remarks.translation: 提示词（Claude标签）：“在Blender中重建1906年4月17日下午地震前的旧金山市场街。范围：从渡轮大厦沿市场街到第五街，包括皇宫酒店、呼叫大楼、纪事报大楼、洛塔喷泉和恩波里姆百货。在建模任何内容之前，请先根据以下资料建立源文件：1899—1905年桑伯恩火灾保险地图（占地轮廓、高度、材料、使用单位）、迈尔斯兄弟影片《市场街之旅》（1906年4月）、OpenSFHistory、国会图书馆和戴维·拉姆齐收藏中的历史照片，以及USGS地形数据。记录每栋建筑的占地轮廓、高度、立面材料、使用单位，并为每项事实注明来源和置信度。全部使用Blender Python构建。不得下载网格、纹理或HDRI。编写可复用的生成器（维多利亚式商业立面、孟莎屋顶、凸窗、遮阳篷、彩绘招牌、煤气灯和电灯路灯、缆车、马拉货车、早期汽车），并根据源文件组装街道，使每栋建筑都能追溯到数据。提供一段沿街向上的10秒视频。”

remarks.name: Aaron Levie
remarks.role: ceo box - your business lives in content. unleash it with AI
remarks.text:
At Box, we've been testing Opus 5.5 on a variety of complex enterprise knowledge work tasks dealing with unstructured data with the Box Agent.  

Overall, we saw frontier capability levels, with major performance improvements over Opus 5. 63% fewer tokens used, 42% less verbosity, and 30% faster vs. Opus 5. And the model itself is cheaper, so this is a major win for any agentic computer use, coding, analytics, or data work that enterprises will be doing.

Here are some examples of the task wins and performance gains across a variety of industry tests that we performed:

• Financial services - due diligence (+39% task accuracy): A year of transaction records, with the job of finding every miscalculation in an acquisition target's pricing tool. Opus 5.5 scored a perfect result on every  attempt in half the words Opus 5 used, consuming 82% fewer tokens overall.

• Technology - cloud cost analysis (+65% task accuracy): Work out what a company should actually change about its cloud spend. Opus 5.5 picked the right basis for the retention calculation and kept the source data's unit conventions straight all the way through, so the number at the end actually holds up. It took half the time Opus 5 took, with 70% fewer tokens.

• Consumer products - client account analysis (+17% task accuracy): Set the onboarding targets for a client account, reading across the signed contract, a satisfaction tracker and a team metrics sheet. The contract never states a senior/junior split, so Opus 5.5 derived it from the 18-person roster and showed the rule it used; several clients had a perfect 10 on individual survey questions, so it averaged each client's responses instead of crowning the single 10. It finished this one in half the time, on 78% fewer tokens. 

• Clinical diagnostics - data analysis (+15% task accuracy): Malaria rapid-test performance across a dry and a wet season: build the patient records out of two clinical PDFs, compute positive test rates by season and gender, and test whether parasite counts really differ between test-positive and test-negative patients. Opus 5.5 caught that the two groups' standard deviations differed more than 100-fold, re-ran it the right way, and found the dry-season difference didn't hold up after all. This accuracy gain came with a final answer that was half the length of Opus 5's, and also needed 78% fewer tokens end to end. 

Customers will be able to build AI Agents with Opus 5.5 shortly in the Box AI Studio.
remarks.translation: 在Box，我们一直在使用Box Agent测试Opus 5.5处理各种涉及非结构化数据的复杂企业知识工作任务。总体而言，我们看到了前沿能力水平，与Opus 5相比性能有了重大提升。与Opus 5相比，使用的token减少了63%，冗长度降低了42%，速度提升了30%。而且模型本身也更便宜，因此对于企业将要进行的任何智能体计算机使用、编码、分析或数据工作来说，这都是一个重大胜利。以下是我们执行的各种行业测试中任务成功和性能提升的一些示例：• 金融服务——尽职调查（任务准确率+39%）：一年的交易记录，任务是找出收购目标定价工具中的每一处计算错误。Opus 5.5在每次尝试中都取得了满分结果，所用字数仅为Opus 5的一半，总体消耗的token减少了82%。• 技术——云成本分析（任务准确率+65%）：确定一家公司实际应当对其云支出做出哪些改变。Opus 5.5为留存计算选择了正确的基础，并全程保持了源数据单位约定的一致性，因此最终得出的数字确实站得住脚。它所用时间仅为Opus 5的一半，token减少了70%。• 消费品——客户账户分析（任务准确率+17%）：为某个客户账户设定引导目标，需要综合已签署合同、满意度追踪表和团队指标表。合同从未说明高级/初级人员比例，因此Opus 5.5从18人名单中推导出了这一比例，并展示了它所使用的规则；若干客户在个别调查问题上获得了满分10分，因此它对每位客户的回答进行了平均，而不是只选出单个10分。它用一半时间完成了这项任务，token减少了78%。• 临床诊断——数据分析（任务准确率+15%）：疟疾快速检测在旱季和雨季的表现：根据两份临床PDF构建患者记录，按季节和性别计算阳性检测率，并检验检测阳性患者与检测阴性患者之间的寄生虫计数是否确实存在差异。Opus 5.5发现两组的标准差相差超过100倍，于是以正确方式重新运行，并发现旱季差异终究并不成立。这一准确率提升的同时，最终答案长度仅为Opus 5的一半，而且端到端所需token也减少了78%。客户很快就能在Box AI Studio中使用Opus 5.5构建AI智能体。

podcasts.originalExcerpt: A few years ago, Caltech Prof. and co-founder of Accelerated Understanding, Anima Anandkumar set out to develop the first open-source weather model with AI. Talking to experts in the field, she was met with skepticism. Weather is chaotic, physics simulations are hard, have been developed for decades, and require supercomputers, the data just isn’t there. Despite reservations, Anima went forth and built. Within a year her team had developed FourCastNet, a predictive model that is competitive with the best physics-based simulations available. Thanks to Anima, and her follow up work, anyone can now predict weather accurately over a short timescale using consumer grade GPUs.
